climbs_list.name: Col de la Croix de l'Arbre

story: The breakaway took over 60 kilometers to form, with the peloton initially controlling the group. The breakaway maintained most of their lead, and the peloton finished just 4 seconds behind. Finn Fisher Black appeared set to win, but Quinn Simmons ultimately claimed the stage victory.
